fullDescription: Renders the default dashboard home screen with repository feed, Copilot prompt area, account repository sidebar, event content, and changelog updates using GitHubDashboard.

Provides the reusable GitHubDashboard default-state composition along with repository cards, split action buttons, searchable repository navigation, prompt input, filter control, and dismissible event panel. It accepts a serializable mode prop and can be reused for dashboard states.
